title: Carry the live state to the dashboard through the existing feed
goal: The thinking snapshot reaches the dashboard through the existing live state and server-sent events, with no new polling
acceptance: GET /api/thinking is read-only and answers admin and read-only clients like GET /api/pilots; it returns the entries of T01 (pilot, role, model, sortie, startedAt) and an empty list when nothing thinks

A change of the registry changes dashboardRevision (src/runtime.ts, src/store.ts: the revision stays two numbers separated by a colon, so the feed's format check in src/dashboard-feed.ts still passes), so the connected dashboard re-reads once per change; no timer or interval is added on the client or the server for this; elapsed time is not pushed

A test across the registry, the revision, the feed and the endpoint: a begin is announced to a connected client, an end is announced, a client with no right gets nothing; the failing join test of T01 now passes up to the endpoint
privacy: Neutral invented pilots, sorties and models only; no owner data or tokens in Git, tests or logs.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one read route and a revision input over the existing feed, with the feed test. Not a measurement.
